name: Formiche Alto (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged with a yellow castle at the lower hoist and a pomegranate flower at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Formiche Alto; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
pomegranate flower at the upper fly
